content.description: Side view of sun roof showing front shoe contact with stopper when sliding roof is fully closed

content.text: When the sliding roof is fully closed, confirm that the front shoes are in contact with the stopper.

content.description: Diagram showing left-right direction adjustment of sun roof by loosening rear shoe bolts and sliding the roof forward and rearward

content.text: Adjust by loosening the rear shoe bolts and sliding the roof forward and rearward. It will adjust automatically.

content.description: Top view of vehicle showing sun roof tilted position with clearance measurement points on left and right front

content.text: (e) In event the sliding roof is tilted. (Difference in the left and right front clearance)

content.description: Detail view showing drive motor cable with notch measurement, indicating 1 notch clearance difference adjustment

items: If the difference is about 2 mm (0.08 in.): Remove the drive motor and shift the cable one notch on the side with larger clearance. Reinstall the motor.

content.description: Diagram showing rear shoe bolt adjustment to readjust sliding roof position when difference is about 1mm

items: If the difference is about 1 mm (0.04 in.): Loosen the rear shoe bolts and readjust the sliding roof to the proper position.
